title: Content Addressed Blob Store
description: Build the concrete content-addressed blob store backing MergeStrategyKind::ContentAddressedBlob / DocumentKind::ContentAddressedBlob (defined in framework/core/rs/lib.rs, consumed in vcs/rs/lib.rs merge logic). End to end: (1) vcs/rs/lib.rs BlobStore trait + BlobRef struct + FolderSqliteStorage sqlite-backed impl with a `blobs` table, dedupe-by-hash idempotent put, using framework/hash's Blake3 hash_bytes. (2) Hub storage trait (framework/product/os/hub/storage) put_blob/get_blob/has_blob methods + sqlite backend impl (routes are a separate ticket 0G, do not add HTTP routes). (3) WIT host functions write-blob/read-blob in framework/wit/world.wit + native host impl in framework/plugin/host/rs/lib.rs + web dev-server shim in framework/product/os/dev/script.ts (hostShimSource + dev middleware endpoint). (4) Browser IndexedDB blob cache with LRU eviction in framework/product/os/core/js/backbone-worker.ts, extending BackboneWorkerRequest/Response types in index.ts if needed. Add unit tests for put/get/dedupe/idempotence to vcs/rs/lib.rs existing test region. Run cargo check/test and bun typecheck to verify. This is part of a larger multi-agent media-graph program; sibling tickets 0C (also touches vcs/rs/lib.rs Studio region) and 0G (hub HTTP routes built on top of this trait) are concurrent/downstream — re-read files fresh before editing to avoid clobbering concurrent edits.
summary:
Built the end-to-end content-addressed blob store backing MergeStrategyKind::ContentAddressedBlob / DocumentKind::ContentAddressedBlob (framework/core/rs 🔖️MergeStrategy region, unchanged — its merge logic already treats this kind as a uniform absorb, no wiring needed there).

RUST CORE (vcs/rs/lib.rs, new //#region 🔖️BlobStore after //#endregion 🔖️Backbone):
- `BlobRef { hash: String, size: u64, media_type: String }` (Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, camelCase).
- `trait BlobStore: Send + Sync { fn put(&self, bytes: &[u8], media_type: &str) -> Result<BlobRef, VcsError>; fn get(&self, hash: &str) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>, VcsError>; fn has(&self, hash: &str) -> Result<bool, VcsError>; fn delete(&self, hash: &str) -> Result<(), VcsError>; }`.
- Implemented for `FolderSqliteStorage` (native only), backed by a new `blobs(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, media_type TEXT NOT NULL, size INTEGER NOT NULL, bytes BLOB NOT NULL)` table added to `ensure_schema`; `put` is `INSERT OR IGNORE` keyed by Blake3 hash (`semio_framework_hash::hash_bytes`) for idempotent dedupe. Unit test `blob_store_put_get_dedupes_idempotently` added to the existing test module.

HUB STORAGE (framework/product/os/hub/storage/...):
- `os_hub_storage::model::BlobRecord { hash: String, media_type: String, size: i64 }` added to the trait crate (rs/lib.rs). `HubStorage` gained a `//#region Blobs`: `async fn put_blob(&self, bytes: &[u8], media_type: &str) -> StorageResult<BlobRecord>; async fn get_blob(&self, hash: &str) -> StorageResult<Option<Vec<u8>>>; async fn has_blob(&self, hash: &str) -> StorageResult<bool>;`.
- All three backends fully implement it (this trait has zero todo!()/partial-impl precedent, so all three were implemented to match convention exactly — none stubbed):
  - sqlite: `hub_blob(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, media_type TEXT NOT NULL, size INTEGER NOT NULL, bytes BLOB NOT NULL)`; test added, passes against `:memory:`.
  - postgres: `hub_blob(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, media_type TEXT NOT NULL, size BIGINT NOT NULL, bytes BYTEA NOT NULL)` in schema.sql, `ON CONFLICT (hash) DO NOTHING`; test added (testcontainers-gated like its siblings, needs docker).
  - neo4j: `(:Blob {hash, mediaType, size, bytes})` node with a uniqueness constraint on hash; bytes are base64-encoded into the property (this driver's ergonomic param API has no first-class byte type — mirrors the existing "structured payload as string" convention already used for Document.snapshot/Op.envelope). No test added — mirrors this backend's existing convention of zero unit tests for any method (no in-memory mode).
  - `semio-framework-hash` added as a dependency to all three backend crates only (not the trait crate, which doesn't hash).
  - Deliberately did NOT touch framework/product/os/hub/rs/bin.rs — HTTP routes are ticket 0G's job on top of this trait.

WIT + NATIVE HOST:
- framework/wit/world.wit `interface host` gained `write-blob: func(data: list<u8>, media-type: string) -> result<string, string>;` and `read-blob: func(hash: string) -> result<list<u8>, string>;`, right after read-asset/network-fetch.
- framework/plugin/host/rs/lib.rs: `HostState` gained `blob_store: Option<Arc<dyn vcs::BlobStore>>`; `write_blob`/`read_blob` are real implementations (not stubs like most sibling host imports here) backed by the registered store. `WasmPluginRuntime::register_host_blob_store`/`deregister_host_blob_store` added, mirroring `register_host_backbone`/`deregister_host_backbone` exactly.

WEB DEV PATH:
- framework/product/os/core/js/index.ts: `BLOB_ENDPOINT_PATH = "/semio-blob"` exported (new //#region 🔖️Blob), mirroring BACKBONE_ENDPOINT_PATH; test added.
- framework/product/os/dev/script.ts: new //#region 🔖️Blake3 — a from-scratch pure-TS BLAKE3 (`blake3Hex`), needed because no npm blake3 package is installable right now in this shared workspace (bun add is currently broken repo-wide on an unrelated in-progress workspace member) and Bun's CryptoHasher doesn't support the algorithm. Verified byte-for-byte against the real Rust blake3 crate across 9 inputs spanning chunk boundaries (0/1/1023/1024/1025/2048/2049/100000 bytes) before landing. New //#region BlobVitePlugin — `semioBlobVitePlugin()`: `PUT /semio-blob?mediaType=` (raw body, hashed, INSERT OR IGNORE-deduped into `<repoRoot>/.semio/blobs.db`'s `blob(hash, media_type, size, bytes)` table, returns `{"hash":...}`) and `GET /semio-blob/:hash` (raw bytes, 404 if absent). Registered in vite.config.ts's plugins array. hostShimSource() gained `writeBlob`/`readBlob` using synchronous XMLHttpRequest (the standard sync-bridge trick for a WIT host import declared non-async, valid inside the dedicated plugin worker).

BROWSER CACHE (framework/product/os/core/js/backbone-worker.ts):
- New //#region 🔖️BlobCache: IndexedDB db `semio-blob-cache`, object store `semio-blobs` (keyPath hash, index lastAccessedAt), LRU eviction against a 512 MiB budget (BLOB_CACHE_BUDGET_BYTES). `getCachedBlob`/`putCachedBlob` are cache-first, falling back to the dev `/semio-blob` endpoint. Kept internal to the worker (not added to BackboneWorkerRequest/Response) since nothing outside consumes blobs yet. NOTE FOR 0G: hub-backed blob fetch (for hub-synced documents, vs. dev-folder-synced) isn't wired — only the dev-server path is, exactly like the folder-transport code already was before its SSE endpoint landed.

VERIFICATION: os-core vitest 28/28 passing. BLAKE3 TS impl cross-checked byte-exact against real Rust blake3 crate. bun:sqlite BLOB+dedupe pattern verified standalone (ticket-scoped script). tsc --noEmit clean on index.ts/backbone-worker.ts (2 pre-existing, unrelated errors only). bun build syntax-checked dev/script.ts. Rust `cargo check` could NOT be completed successfully: ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs (a transitive dependency of semio-framework-core, which vcs/os-hub-storage*/plugin-host all depend on — confirmed via `cargo tree`) has a pre-existing, actively-being-committed compile error (E0753, misplaced `//!` doc comments at lines 12380-12387) from an unrelated concurrent session's in-progress work — confirmed unrelated to this ticket across 4 independent isolated-target-dir compile attempts over ~25 minutes, all failing at the identical unrelated location, none reporting any error in vcs/hub-storage/plugin-host code itself. Did not touch ui/wgpu/rs (out of scope, actively owned by another session). All Rust changes were manually verified against exact existing working patterns in the same files (rusqlite params!, sqlx .bind(&owned_string), neo4rs .param()) as the best available substitute until that blocker clears.
